concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-api-explorer-balanceplatform-webhooks-latest-post-balanceplatform-paymentinstrument-updated]] — 2026-09-15-captured Balance Platform incoming payment-instrument-updated webhook contract for card or bankAccount resources, with optional resource object, conditional required identifiers and irreversible `closed` status; the suspended-card example is not payment proof.

- [[source-adyen-api-explorer-balanceplatform-webhooks-latest-post-balanceplatform-paymentinstrument-updated]] — 2026-09-15-captured payment-instrument-updated webhook reference also covering `bankAccount` instruments; optional branch details and a resource update do not prove account funding or transfer completion.

- [[source-adyen-api-explorer-balanceplatform-webhooks-latest-post-balanceplatform-paymentinstrument-updated]] — 2026-09-15-captured `balancePlatform.paymentInstrument.updated` event contract; a `2xx` receiver acknowledgement is separate from the instrument update and any financial outcome.
